fields.gap: The film allowable 1.5e9 Pa is an owner assumption with no datasheet, and wrinkling, puncture, sag area and shear transfer to members are unmodelled. For aluminum the film never binds (>=0.838 at the best point), but for SiC and the CNT projection it is the second limit and binds from s=1.0.
fields.direction: Pin a real film (material, thickness, seaming) before crediting any SiC-family margin.
fields.effect: SiC-family rows are film-capped in reality until the film is real.
